description: Curated SHA256 → known-script mapping. When Deep Analysis computes the hash of a downloaded script and finds a match, the user sees 'matches X (vendor verified)' instead of having to manually compare. Initial bootstrap is deliberately small — entries grow crowdsourced (issue or PR) as users report verified scripts. Keep the most-deployed first-party libraries here, not custom enterprise builds.
note: The hashes below are illustrative placeholders. Real hashes are computed once over the exact published file (https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id=...) and pinned per file. To add a verified entry: download the file, compute sha256 (e.g. `shasum -a 256 file.js`), and submit it with vendor + version + url.
